what_happened: Dispatch's secondary scope item cites scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh:717-720 as a one-line WIRED_REPO detector addition site, but that script does not exist anywhere in this repo's working tree or git history -- only prose citations in task-abandon-mode.md and skill-todo/SKILL.md describe the hazard. Likely a stale cross-repo migration citation. Flagged in report rather than implemented as a guess.

Dispatch-embedded snapshot counts (task 177 whole-directory entry; 28 of 52 missing file_scope) were fully stale against the live validate-state.sh run: task 177 does not exist in this repo's state.json at all, and only 3 of 137 non-terminal tasks (567,568,607) are missing file_scope, not 28. Live Check 8 instead names projects 473 and 518. All recommendations in the report are based on the live run, per the dispatch's own warning.

Planning discovered scripts/backfill-file-scope.sh already exists and handles the automated half of defect 2; its --dry-run run cleanly explains why 567/568/607 remain absent (plan-less, deliberately left absent per its Decision 6), so the plan only has to cover the hand-declaration case the tool declines by design.

Dispatch description cites 'Check 9 (duplicates)' as enumerating the missing-file_scope defect; live validate-state.sh shows duplicates are Check 9 (already PASS) and the missing/null/empty defect is Check 10. Also, --strict cannot serve as this task's acceptance bar: it additionally promotes two out-of-scope Check 4 unknown-entry-field WARNs (audit_override, audit_verdict) to exit-blocking, so the plan's bar is per-check cleanliness on Checks 8/9/10 in base mode instead.
